title: iris douglasiana var. beecheyana
intro: Iris douglasiana var. beecheyana, commonly known as the Douglas iris, is a plant species in the iris family. It is used in traditional medicine, primarily for its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of this plant include treating wounds, skin infections, and other inflammatory conditions due to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, promoting tissue repair, and preventing infection. The bioactive constituents of Iris douglasiana var. beecheyana include flavonoids, saponins, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
